castNote: Every on'yomi is played by one recurring character whose English name starts with or clearly contains that sound (ショウ = Showman, カン = Kangaroo): long readings ending in ウ/イ get a stretched vowel (コ Collie vs コウ Coach, ケ Kettle vs ケイ Cake), and endings in ク/ツ/ッ/キ/チ keep that consonant (コク Cockatoo, ジツ Jiu-jitsu fighter). Voiced readings (゛) use a sound-alike 'muddy cousin' of the unvoiced character, always shown splattered with two drops of mud like the two ゛ dots and, where possible, sharing its scene (シ Sheep / ジ Jeep, ショウ Showman / ジョウ Joker, コウ Coach / ゴウ Goalie, セン Sensei / ゼン Zen monk, ヒ Hippo / ビ Beaver), so mud always means ゛. Where the short and long readings could be mixed up, they share a world and size marks length: キョ is the Kyoto maiko (the young apprentice), キョウ the grown Kyoto Geisha.

On the left, a slab of [ice]; on the right, a clerk lets out a huge [yawn]: '{Next}!' ~two geese~ skid across the ice to the counter, and a mud-splattered ~Jeep~ honks, waiting behind them.
A ~Sheep~ banker perched on top bleats '[next]!' as customer after customer pours their {assets} into the heap of [shells] below her hooves, until she's buried to the chin in wealth.

On the right, a [taskmaster] cracks his whip at a signpost pointing in every [direction] on the left. The cage door bursts open and ~Hobo~, locked up for years, is {set free}, sprinting off with his bindle.

vocab.m: to let go; to set free

cards.story: ~Zorro~ slashes a Z into the [soil] on the left, and the molehill beside it, [formerly] tiny, doubles with every slash. You watch the {increase} until it buries his horse to the ears.
At {year-end}, a [stop] sign on top halts the birthday [parade]. Tucked inside it, a [little] kid blows out the candles, and ~Cyclops~ squints his one giant eye to count them: another year older.
You stand a prickly ~Cactus~ on the [stone] on the left, and a [crane] on the right hammers it with its beak a hundred times. Not one wobble: you have complete {assurance} it's fixed.
On the left, you [say] 'please'. On the right, you [endure] a ~Ninja~ flinging shuriken that pin your sleeves to the wall. You never flinch, so he finally bows and {acknowledges} you.
A [battle cry] erupts on top of your [heart], and a ~Kangaroo~ trapped inside your chest starts boxing your ribs. Pounding, sobbing, laughing: you're flooded with raw {emotion}.
~Hitman~ draws a dagger [slash] straight through a [heart], and the drops splash out on both sides. He never misses: {invariably}, every target, every time.
On the left, your bare [fingers] curl into a fist; on the right lies the [street]. You {strike} the asphalt again and again until it cracks open and your knuckles throb.
A 200-year-old man keeps a [walking stick] [by one's side] and stabs it into the [soil] beneath him to prove he still {exists}. His ribs clang like a mud-splattered ~Xylophone~ with every stab.
On the left, your [fingers] grab the [missile] on the right and {throw} it at the ~nagger~ next door. ~Toad~ snags it mid-air with his tongue and swallows it, cheeks glowing.

On the left, rushing [water]; on the right, an [infant flood] of giggling babies swept head first downstream by the {current}. ~Ryu the dragon~ coils around them, a scaly lifeguard steering them home.

vocab.m: to let flow; to wash away

cards.story: A [house] roof clamps down over a whole [valley] to {contain} it, the walls bulging with lakes and mooing cows. ~Yoda~, inside, raises one finger and holds the walls together.
Below the [esteem]ed family crest hangs a fresh [towel], as {usual}, every single morning. And as usual, a mud-splattered ~Joker~ wipes his greasy face paint on it, cackling.
At his {post}, a night guard presses his [ear], on the left, to a wall throbbing with a [sound fiesta] on the right. The bass turns him into a ~Shock victim~, hair frizzled, but he stays on duty.
A [net] drops from above and pins a ~Chimpanzee~ to an ~oak~ table [straightaway] below, in perfect {placement}, like a vase on display. He screeches but can't move an inch.
On the left stands [wheat]; on the right, a ~Lizard~ swings a [saber] with its tail and harvests it in one stroke, then sells it back to the farmer for a huge {profit}.
Under [one] rusty pipe, a parched man begs: 'My only {request}: a single [drop] of [water]!' A ~Cucumber~ hanging above squeezes itself until its juice drips into his mouth.
A [jewel] sits on the left; on the right, the king's [request]: 'Make it round!' A ~Cucumber~ rolls over the jewel again and again until it's polished into a perfect {ball}.
Each [person] stands beside a [vase] on their right: the taller the vase, the higher the {rank}. An ~Eagle~ swoops down and snatches the general's vase, demoting him on the spot.
~Ken doll~ is the [person] on the left, caught holding hooves with the neighbor's [cow] on the right. A scandalous {affair}! He blushes plastic pink as reporters' cameras flash.
A [person] stands on the left beside every word they [say] on the right. A ~Shinto priest~ ties a sacred rope around their tongue: break your word, lose your tongue. Now you have total {faith}.
A [person] on the left breaks the [rule] on the right and gets shoved to the {side} of the road, squashed flat against a ~guava~ cart. Pink juice splatters everywhere.
A lazy [person] on the left dumps every {responsibility} onto the [porter] on the right: suitcases, kids, tax forms. The porter is a ~Ninja~, silently catching everything that topples off.
Beneath a drooping [flag], {bureau} clerks stamp the same [phrase] on endless forms piled below. A ~Kyokushin karate master~ marches in and chops the whole stack in half with one yell.
A [tree] grows a whole [rice field] on top instead of {fruit}: square, muddy apples. A ~Car~ rams the trunk, and the result is a soggy field crashing onto its roof.
Every [door] on the left in this {place} has an [axe] stuck in it from the right. The ~Shopkeeper~ who sells doors swung them himself, and now the whole neighborhood must buy from him.
A ~Saxophonist~ takes the [saw] on the right to the [sun] on the left and slices off {yesterday} like stale bread. He plays a mournful solo as it sinks away.
A ~Soldier~, [bound up (small)] on top, wriggles free, grabs a [broom], and jams a [barb] down through its middle as a spear, ready to {contend} with anyone who comes near.
Under a yoke bar on top, two buckets hang side by side inside a frame. ~Leo the Lion~ hoists it and carries {both} buckets at once, sloshing milk everywhere, roaring at the weight.
Judge ~Han Solo~ delivers his {judgment}: a [saber] on the right chops the disputed cake in [half] on the left. A mud-splattered ~Banjo player~ who lost the case strums a sad ballad.
Beside the [moon] on the left, a bull in [horned heavens] headgear stands on [power]ful legs, roaring in {victory}. The ~Showman~ hands him the trophy: a cup crammed with hissing ~cats~.
A ~hick~ and an ~Intern~ play tug-of-war with the [bow] on the left; they {pull} so hard the string snaps off and stands straight up on the right like a [walking stick].
A [skeleton] races a ~Car~ along the [road] wrapped beneath him and {overdoes} it, sprinting past the finish line until his bones rattle loose and scatter across the asphalt.
On every special {occasion}, villagers climb the [pinnacle] on the left to perform a [ritual] on the right. ~Cyclops~, guest of honor, must stare into the bonfire with his one huge eye, unblinking.

The [person] on the left guards a [lineage] scroll on the right listing who's related to whom. As the {person in charge}, he decides who gets ~Cake~ at the reunion, slamming the knife down on distant cousins.
On the left, a keeper balances a [spoon] atop a [dart]; on the right, a [halberd tip] hangs over the [zoo] gate. 'I'll catch it!' A mud-splattered ~Gibbon~ squints in total {doubt}.
When your [state of mind] on the left is painted bright [blue] on the right, your {feelings} leak out as blue tears. A mud-splattered ~Joker~ laps them up and paints a grin on your face.
~Santa~ pays you a surprise {visit} riding a [St. Bernard dog]. He jabs you awake with his [elbow] from on top, while the dog sheds [three hairs] from below onto your pillow.
An [apple] on top sprouts [walking legs] below and struts down the street: how {unusual}! A ~Hen~ squawks, chases it, and pecks a bite, then lays a red apple-shaped egg.

A ~Moose~ ducks under a [banner top] and stomps on a [wooden lattice] laid across [one] plank over an [oven fire] until it collapses and burns to pure {nothingness}. A mud-splattered ~Bookworm~ crawls out of the empty grate, unharmed.

The knitting {association} ties [thread] from the left around every [shelf] on the right until the library is one giant web. The ~Sorceress~ yanks the threads with her wand, sorting members into teams.

The ~Kite flyer~ snags his kite on a [horn] on the left, then slides a [sword] through the rope knot that ties up a [cow] on the right, {unraveling} the rope strand by strand. The happy cow trots free.
On the left, professors [say] their [theory] on the right, louder and louder, until the {argument} shakes the lecture hall. A ~Longhorn bull~ charges between the podiums and ends the debate.
Your ~Mentor~ slams a boxy {mask} onto your face: a flat bar across the brow, a long nose ridge down the middle, square eyeholes. 'Now go face the world,' he laughs.
A circus ~Gnome~ shows off his {ability}: balancing on one [elbow] atop a slab of [flesh] on the left, while juggling two stacked [spoon]s on the right. The crowd hurls mushrooms.
A ~Unicorn~'s horn bursts up through the top of a square rice field. The farmer screams '{Wherefore}?!', demanding a reason. The unicorn just shrugs: 'Freedom!'
In the circus {performance}, the [sign of the tiger] on the right leaps through a flaming hoop into a pool of [water] on the left. The ~Engineer~ cranks the hoop higher until its whiskers singe.
A man [bound up] in ropes on top kneels in {defeat} as his [shells] treasure below is dragged away. The victor slaps his face with a wet ~mackerel~, and a mud-splattered ~Bookworm~ records the score.
A [woman] on the left is so {fond} of the [child] on the right that she knits him tiny ~ski~ boots and kisses every toe. ~Coach~ blows his whistle: 'Enough cuddling, hit the slopes!'
The ~Showman~ hurls a bucket of [water] from the left at a [little] flame dancing on top of the [moon], and {extinguishes} it with a giant hiss. The audience is plunged into darkness.
A ~Sumo wrestler~ sits under the roof of a [house], stuck to the floor by sticky [glue] under his belly: the ultimate {guard}. While the owners are away, burglars bounce right off him.
A [tree] at the world's {extremity} grows [one] top branch far longer than the rest, poking into the void. A ~Matador~ teeters on its very tip, waving his cape at nothing.
{Young} festival-goers wear [flowers] on their heads and wave their [right] hands below, dancing so ~wacky~ that their grandparents' dentures fall out.
On top, [flowers]; in the middle, every [generation]; at the bottom, the ancient [tree]. Each generation's blossoms fall as one giant {leaf} pile, and you leap in shouting '~ha~!'
A [dog] on the right guards a slab of [flesh] on the left, both roasting over an [oven fire] below. 'You eat that {sort of thing}?' A mud-splattered ~Zen monk~ shrugs, takes a bite: 'Naturally.'
Wilted [flowers] {fall} from the top; [each] petal splashes into the [water] on the left and yelps a tiny '~ouchie~!', like a thousand stubbed toes.
The [sun] rises over the [capital] below and bakes the skyline into a giant ~Cake~, frosting dripping from every tower: breathtaking {scenery} that smells of vanilla.

A cop towers on top of his loudspeaker, struck with [awe] at his own voice; below, every word he [say]s booms across the city. He {admonishes} a jaywalker, then smashes a ~Cake~ in his face as a final warning.
The ~Showman~ balances a [vase] on top of his [hood], walks it on [human legs], and whispers through a [mouth] inside to {make a deal}: 'Buy this vase, get a free tent!'
~Hobo~ hops freight trains to {call on} every relative in the country. On the left he [say]s 'Which [direction]?' to strangers on the right, then knocks at dawn, smelling of soot.
On the right, your [horned brother] can't [say] one word on the left without a ten-hour {explanation} of his horns. A ~Setter dog~ falls asleep halfway, snoring on all four feet.
A ~Samurai~ paints a red [slash] down a [sheep] on top, so the [craft] fair judges below can see the {distinction} between it and the wool sculptures.
Two lovers gaze [inter-] into each other's eyes on top, and a new {concept} drops into each [heart] below. A ~Soldier~ watching them imagines a wedding and bursts into tears.
An upside-down [infant] on top grows plump [flesh] below as you {bring up} the baby on gallons of milk. An ~Icky slime blob~ drips goo on it, and it grows even faster.
After the [fiesta] on the right, only a pile of [bones] is left on the left: the {remainder} of the feast. A mud-splattered ~Zanta~, Santa's muddy twin, gnaws them, sighing, 'What a pity.'
Each [husband] on the left must [see] himself measured against the {standard} ruler on the right before marriage. A ~Kiwi bird~ judge stands on tiptoe on his head to read it.
A sword [slash] knocks the [husband]'s head-pin askew, and he {loses} his wedding ring down the drain. A ~Bedsheet ghost~ floats up with it, giggling at his mistake.
[sparkler]s fizz on top of a [crown], and beneath it ~Robot~ workers pump all their [power] into brutal fireworks-factory {labor}, all night, until their joints glow red.
A soldier [going] off to war on the left has one {duty}: carry the [missile] on the right. He straps it onto a ~Yak~, which groans but proves very useful.

A [person] on the left puffs a [rising cloud] of smoke signals on the right to {transmit} a message. A mud-splattered ~Dentist~ on the next hill reads them in his little mirror and yanks a tooth in reply.
A [saber] on the right herds [bones] on the left into a perfect single {file}, a skeleton army queueing for the train; last in line, a trembling ~Lettuce~ awaits the blade.
One [person] on the left marches in a [file] on the right so perfectly that the drill sergeant holds him up as the {example}. A ~Raven~ perches on his helmet, copying his every step.
A [person] on the left hugs a friend drowning in [melancholy] on the right with such {tenderness} that a ~Unicorn~ trots up and licks away the friend's tears with its rainbow tongue.
The ~Footballer~, a [person] on the left, dives headfirst into a vat of [glue] on the right and {adheres} to the ceiling. Every ball kicked at him sticks to his face.
~Shinto priest~ skewers a [sunbox (say)] on a [walking stick] like a microphone and {speaketh} humbly into it: 'I humbly apply…'

At the [altar] on the left, a voice [speaketh] like thunder from the right: the {gods} have arrived! The ~Shinto priest~ faints, and a mud-splattered ~Ginger cat~ squeezes out of the shrine to greet them.
A sack of [rice] hangs from a [fishhook] on the left. The mud-splattered ~Dandy~ swings an [axe] from the right and cuts the line: total {severance}. Then he refuses to pick it up.
A [person] on the left {equips} for the climb: [flowers] on top to plant at the summit, and a rope to [utilize] under the [cliff]. A mud-splattered ~Beaver~ gnaws through the rope as you prepare.
Deep in a [cave], [twenty] damp [towel]s are spread on the floor below, each a {seat} for the meeting. The ~Secretary~ slaps name tags on them; the latecomer sits in a puddle.
To {transit} the river, you must wade the [water] on the left at exactly 45 [degrees] on the right, or be swept away. Halfway across, a ~Water balloon~ bursts on your head.
Every [dollar] on top must be paid in heavy [shells] below, so even a bus ticket is a crushing {expense}. A ~Hippo~ hauls a wheelbarrow of them, sweating, just to pay the fare.

A pot-bellied {somebody} stands sideways, ribs bulging, one long leg kicking out the bottom stroke, pointing at himself yelling '~Me~! Me!' A ~Shinto priest~ purifies his whole body with a slap of paper streamers.
A cat {chases} ~Tweety bird~ along the [road] wrapped beneath and over a [mound] of dirt on top, Tweety screaming like a police siren the whole way.
A drunk ~Hyena~ {distributes} shots from the [whiskey bottle] on the left to every guest, but keeps the last drop on the right for him[self], cackling while you worry.
A monstrous [root] bursts up out of the [road] beneath it, and the charging ~Tiger~ army must {retreat}, tails between their legs, yowling.
~Genghis Khan~'s horde climbs the [pinnacle] on the left, where one giant [root] juts out on the right like a border post: the {limit}. He hacks all night, but it won't budge; his empire ends here.

vocab.m: to restrict; to be limited to

cards.story: A [fishhook] on the left snags your payday envelope, and you stuff the whole {income} down your pants [crotch] on the right. A giant ~Shoe~ stomps over and sniffs the bulge, smelling cash.
Standing between the two halves of a busy [boulevard], a [corn stalk] reads a mud-splattered ~Jutsu scroll~ and performs its martial {art}, spinning its leaves like nunchucks while cars swerve.

Inside a [house], a weed [growing up] through the floorboards shoves its stem into a sleeper's open [mouth] and chokes him: real {harm}. Down in the cellar, a mud-streaked ~Tour guide~ grins and shows it to tourists; he planted it.
After the [harm] on the left is done, a judge's [saber] on the right slices the wreckage into exact pieces, one {proportion} per victim. Everyone stays ~wary~, sure their slice is smaller.
A [turkey] on the right tries to sculpt itself from sticky [Sino- clay] on the left: hilariously {difficult}, feathers glued everywhere. ~Nanny~ scrubs its beak, scolding, and gets stuck too.

A [tree] rips up its roots and gallops off with two riders sitting back to back, like the [north] sign carved through its trunk. You {ride} it bareback; a mud-splattered ~Joker~ clings behind, shrieking.
A ~Neanderthal~ pounds his chest, his [heart] below roaring 'I want it [now]!' so hard the {wish} burns through his fur. When it doesn't come true, he sobs: 'Regrettable.'
An ~Eagle~ drops two identical [locket]s onto the [road] below: one holds your photo, the other a stranger's from ~Chicago~. Spot the {difference} or it carries you off.
A [person] on the left must [move] crates from dawn to midnight, sweat spraying: that's {work}. His foreman is a mud-splattered ~Dodo~, pecking his ankles bloody whenever he pauses.
The ~Shushing librarian~ taps a [wheat] stalk on the left with her ruler until its seeds grow [heavy] as bowling balls; each one cracks open to hatch a brand-new, bizarre {species}.
Press dough through an [open frame] on the left while [three hairs] on the right slice it like a cookie cutter into any {shape}: a ~Cake~, or a muddy ~Gyoza dumpling~ doll.
A heavy [shelf] on the left topples toward you; a mud-splattered ~Jockey~ gallops in, flexes his tiny [power] arm on the right and props it up: {help} has arrived!

vocab.m: to be saved; to be helpful

cards.story: ~Kyoto Geisha~ kneels and {submits} a tray of scalding tea: one [person] on the left offers it to the crowd huddled [together] on the right, who bow and burn their tongues.
~Coach~ ties you to a [tree] on the left, straps a [lattice] frame to your back on the right, and barks until your {posture} is ramrod straight.
A ~Sailor~ wearing a [soldier]'s helmet up top bellows orders; his {voice} is so loud it shreds the [flag] flapping beneath him.
A mud-splattered ~Banjo player~ hands numbered [valentine] cards to lovers lined up in the [rice field] below; each waits for a {turn} to be serenaded, ankle-deep in mud.
A long hairy [rooftop tail] dangles under your [house] roof. A ~Taxi driver~ hooks it to his bumper and tows the whole building across town: {home} delivery!
A mud-splattered ~Gourmet~ welds his kitchen {tools} into a monster: a giant [eye] on top, [one] cutting board as its belly, and hairy [animal legs] below that scuttle off with his dinner.
~Coach~ jams a lit [sparkler] onto your head and screams 'RUN!'; your [human legs] below sprint so fast you blaze blinding {rays} across the track.
A ~Tiger~ force-feeds a [St. Bernard dog] doughnuts until it's hugely {plump}; a [drop] of grease squeezes out between its hind legs.
Under a [house] roof hangs [one] lid over a giant [mouth]; ~Footballer~ kicks a whole [rice field] up into it from below, and it spews gold coins: instant {wealth}.
~Cook~ picks the [flowers] growing on top of an [old] grave and brews them into tea so bitter you gag and writhe in {suffering}.
Under your [house] roof, a ~Kayak~ paddles up to [each] bedroom door and dumps off a dripping, snoring {guest}.
~Shopkeeper~ glues [walking legs] onto her unsold junk on the left; it marches into the howling [wind] on the right and is blown away. Easiest way to {dispose} of anything.
~Hyena~ plays the [taskmaster] on the right, whipping your [shells] on the left into powder and cackling at your total {failure}.
The ~Sheikh~ rides up to a deafening [sound fiesta] on the right; his {discriminating} ear can [say] which drum is fake, and he silences it.
A mud-splattered ~Bowler~ lies curled like a [fishhook], his [top hat] perched above: the {deceased} rolled one gutter ball too many.
The ghost of a [deceased], mud-splattered ~Bowler~ bowls at the [moon] each night with one {ambition}: knock it down and be crowned [king] beneath it.
A mud-splattered ~Beaver~ trims a [sheep]'s wool into a tiara and perches it atop a [St. Bernard dog], who wins the {beauty} pageant in tears.
Only after you crawl the whole [road] does the ~Tattoo artist~ ink [happiness] onto your back; you stand up bleeding, sobbing, {accomplished}.
On the left, a [turkey] with [flowers] on its head squawks from [two mouths] inside ~Kangaroo~'s pouch; she hops up a cliff on the right so they can [see] the {outlook}.
~Intern~ shoves a [St. Bernard dog] into a box, where it's [pent in] and howls all night. The {cause} of the office chaos? Him, grinning.
~Engineer~ fences in a giant in a [long robe] until he's [pent in], then bolts swings to his sleeves: the {park}'s biggest ride.
A lightning slash strikes across a hooked stick: ~Cyclops~ gets zapped in his single eye and is suddenly a {genius}, scribbling calculus on the cave wall, smoke rising from his head.
A [genius] on the right hammers a mud-splattered ~Xylophone~ made of [shells] on the left; every note spits coins into his {property}, and a ~Cyclops~ stuffs them into a wallet.
~Sonic the Hedgehog~ zooms by so fast the [child] [by one's side] asks, 'Does he even exist?' 'I {suppose},' sighs a muddy ~Amazon warrior~. 'I know him.'
A [vulture] on a [crown] guards a beating [heart], but the heart sprouts [walking legs] and runs off; a giant ~Eyeball~ falls in {love} and chases it, weeping.
A ~Hamster~ grinds a [stone] on the left against a drum [pelt] on the right until he can {rend} it open and burst through, squeaking in triumph.
A [king] on the right opens his [mouth] on top and gulps [wheat] from the left to test the {extent} of his belly; ~Tailor~ frantically lets out his trousers, inch by inch.
On the left, a [tree]; on the right, a [sheep (tailless)] lounges in bath [water], demanding letters addressed 'Sheep, {Esq.}' ~Yoda~, its butler, bows: 'Honored, I am.'
~Tarzan~ swings in, drops a hissing [scorpion] on the right onto the [person] on the left, then points: 'Blame the {other} guy!'
A [person] on the left demands cash [straightaway]: a ~Chimpanzee~ slaps a {price} tag on your horse, which gives a horrified ~neigh~.
In a frozen [cave], a mud-splattered ~Czar~ in a fur hat orders the cavemen to [sit on the ground]: finally, somewhere to {sit}.
Lazy ~Eagle~ ties a [pennant] under the blazing [sun] so the heat flaps it for him: flying made {easy}. ~Echo~ trades her voice to buy the trick.
~Captain Hook~ prays at the [altar] on the left; [wealth] rains down on the right as a {blessing}, and he snags every gold coin on his hook.
Under a [house] roof, a creepy candle [ritual] is underway. A ~Satellite~ spies from orbit, can {guess} exactly what's going on, and calls the police.
~Mantis~ pours [water] from the left over the [flowers] on top until [both] buckets beneath are {full}, then drinks until its belly bursts.
A ~Car~ with a [Big Dipper] ladle for a crane on the right scoops [wheat] on the left into bins, sorting each grain into its own {department}.
A [negative] sign jams into a ~Hippo~'s [mouth] below, so it can only bellow 'NO!', loud enough to {negate} everything you say.
A mud-splattered ~Goalie~ opens his [mouth] on top and hollers your embarrassing {nickname}; the [fishhook] below snags your shorts and drags you into his net.
On a [mound] on the left, a ~Sheep~ {expert} cracks [one] wet [towel] on the right so precisely it snuffs out candles; students faint.
A ~Lobster~ stomps the same [leg] on the left onto [each] spot on the right, over and over, until a deep {path} is worn into the earth.
~Coach~ blows his whistle atop the [pinnacle] on the left: you must {descend} the [steps] on wobbling [walking legs], one by one, while he jogs backward beside you.
Out of a [hole] above, a [St. Bernard dog] lunges and {stabs} its snout into your plate of ~Tater Tots~: suddenly, they're gone.
A ~Shinto priest~ pours [water] from the left into a [deep hole] on the right; it's so {deep} he never hears a splash, leans in, and tumbles after it.
Your boss pays your {salary} in [thread] on the left; ~Cucumber~ must [fit] all of it into his tiny wallet on the right, stuffing until he splits.
~Mayor~ opens a [mouth] tucked under his [orders] and barks one word that seals your {fate}: live or die.
A ~Kiwi bird~ [bound up (small)] in rope teeters on top of a [cliff]; below, a giant [stamp] slams up and down: {dangerous}!
A [mouth] on the left bellows '[ha!]' and then '~Yo, boo~!' on the right; the {call} sends ~Collie~ sprinting home, panting.
A ~Colosseum gladiator~ hides behind a [tree] marked with [crossed sticks] on top; a ~Satellite~ fires a [missile] from the right to {kill} him.
Your [tongue] on the left burns from the boss's [spicy] curry on the right, so you {resign} on the spot and leap into a mud-splattered ~Jeep~ roaring away.
A weed [growing up] on top cracks your piggy bank of [shells] below; ~Secretary~ jabs her clipboard at you: the {blame} is yours.
~Secretary~ stacks [wheat] on the left to the ceiling; when the {volume} topples and buries the office, she dumps the [blame] on you.
A ~Hippo~ sits down on a comb and snaps it in two; now the halves bristle back to back, teeth pointing away, totally {un-}friendly.
~Coach~, a weathered [person] on the left, leans on a [walking stick], tugs his [cap brim] and flings a [dart] into the clouds to test the {climate}; it falls back dripping.
You open a tiny [umbrella] over the [tree] beneath it, and ~Yogurt~ pours from the sky: {too much}! It overflows the umbrella and drowns the tree in gloop.
On the [pinnacle] on the left there's [too much] luggage, so you {exclude} the extra: the mud-splattered ~Jockey~ gets thrown off first.
~Sock puppet~ clamps its [mouth] around the middle of a [tree] and squeezes it into a tight {bundle}, promising to let go later.
A ~Sock puppet~ straps a [bundle] of rockets to his back and blasts down the [road], {quick} as lightning, burning skid marks.
At the end of the [road] you [gaze up] at a mud-splattered ~Gator~ holding a {welcome} banner; it hugs you, teeth and all.
